text:
morgan: Hey team — saw weird eviction churn spikes during yesterday's multi-tenant load test. Hot prefixes are losing residency and causing rehydrate tail latency.
anya: Yikes. I saw evict_count/min go up ~4x during the spike. Tail p99 token latency climbed too. Dashboard: https://dash/redwood/kvcache/evict_churn :grimacing:
kevin: Did we change the sweep timing recently? We bumped the global eviction sweep to 100ms last week as part of the coalescer tweak.
morgan: Here's the test node config I pulled from the staging instance:
```
evict_sweep_ms: 100
evict_coalesce_window_ms: 50
prefill_batch_limit: 128
```
samir: My gut: sweep + aggressive prefill are contending for slab allocations. Sweep is eager and can preempt prefixes that are mid-prefill, which forces rehydrates.
anya: Agree. We should add a counter that correlates sweep ops vs prefill ops per-prefix (sweep_vs_prefill_ops) so we can prove the contention hypothesis.
liz: Ops note: adding many booleans makes surface area hard. Maybe expose one adaptive knob instead of many small flags.
kevin: Proposal: when a node sees active prefill for a prefix, temporarily increase coalesce window for sweep on that node (e.g. 200ms for 30s) so sweep is less aggressive.
samir: That seems reasonable. Also we need a correctness guard: if prefill_in_progress(prefix) then skip evict for that prefix even if score suggests eviction. Pseudo:
```
if prefill_in_progress(prefix):
    return SKIP_EVICT
```
morgan: SGTM. Can we also tag prefill ops with origin (hosted/dedicated/private) so we can check tenant-specific behavior in the canary?
anya: Yes — add tag origin=dedicated to the prefill telemetry. I'll add the metric and dashboard panel.
kevin: I'll spike the change: set node-level window bump when prefill activity > threshold. Will run canary tomorrow against the hotkey synthetic suite.
morgan: Please also include a small safety: any prefix skipped for eviction must still be bounded (e.g. max skip window 60s) so we don't leak memory forever.
samir: And include fairness test: 10x synthetic run with many small tenants and few hot ones to ensure long-tail fairness isn't regressed.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout started for kevin/evict-coalesce-experiment at 2025-03-21T09:10Z :rocket:
anya: :thumbsup: I'll watch dashboards and post results in #eng-runtime after the first 30m.
morgan: Thanks. I'll open a tiny runbook and observability ticket: "kvcache: prefill-sweep backoff experiment" and document rollback criteria (p99 token latency, evict_count/min, memory leak).
